name: coordinator-buffer-derived-only
body: The coordinator buffers only the derived projection. The coordinator performs the durable write itself, directly, one commit per logical mutation — it owns the node-file read-modify-write and the `git::commit_files` commit (coordinator-single-writer), so durable node-file writes are NOT deferred or buffered; only the derived DB flush is deferred/batched into one ingest (or a bounded number) at `apg session end`. Durable writes are never buffered in memory without a WAL. Acceptance: killing the session between mutations loses no durable write; only a rebuildable DB flush is outstanding, and one logical mutation → one commit still holds.
